proof:
Source: the integrability of the cut-off test functions that the parent proof integrates against blow-ups in steps 0(d), 3(vii) and 7 (needed to turn convergent test integrals into mass bounds). Notation: G := Grassmannian N n, Z := ℝ^N × G, Φ(z) := (t⁻¹ • (z.1 − ξ), z.2), so that V_{ξ,t} := rescaledMeasure V ξ t = ofReal(t⁻¹^n) • (V.measure).map Φ.

1. (Pulled-back test function.) Φ is a homeomorphism of Z with inverse Ψ(z) := (ξ + t • z.1, z.2) (t ≠ 0); in particular Φ is continuous, measurable and cocompact. Let H := F ∘ Φ ∈ C_c(Z, ℝ) (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.comp F Φ.toCocompactMap). Then tsupport H ⊆ Φ⁻¹(tsupport F) (tsupport_comp_subset_preimage), and for z ∈ tsupport H the hypothesis applied to Φ z ∈ tsupport F gives z.1 = ξ + t • (t⁻¹ • (z.1 − ξ)) ∈ U. So tsupport H ⊆ U ×ˢ univ.

2. (A compact base.) Let K := Prod.fst '' tsupport H ⊆ ℝ^N. K is compact (continuous image of the compact set tsupport H), K ⊆ U by step 1, and support H ⊆ tsupport H ⊆ K ×ˢ univ. By V.finite_on_compact, V.measure (K ×ˢ univ) ≠ ∞.

3. (H is V-integrable.) H is continuous with compact support, hence bounded: |H z| ≤ M for all z (HasCompactSupport.exists_bound_of_continuous); it is continuous, hence a.e. strongly measurable. Thus H is integrable on K ×ˢ univ (Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded, using step 2), and because support H ⊆ K ×ˢ univ, H is integrable on Z with respect to V.measure (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset).

4. (Transfer to the blow-up.) F is continuous, hence a.e. strongly measurable for (V.measure).map Φ, and Φ is measurable; so F is integrable for (V.measure).map Φ if and only if F ∘ Φ = H is integrable for V.measure (integrable_map_measure), which holds by step 3. Finally V_{ξ,t} = c • (V.measure).map Φ with c := ofReal(t⁻¹^n) ≠ ∞, so F is integrable for V_{ξ,t} (Integrable.smul_measure). ∎

theorem Submission.intcpt_diag_rescaled_integrable : ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ) (F : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), 0 < t → (∀ z ∈ tsupport F, ξ + t • z.1 ∈ U) → Integrable (fun z ↦ F z) (rescaledMeasure V ξ t) := by
  intro N n U V ξ t F ht hF
  let Φ : Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n ≃ₜ Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n :=
    { toFun := fun z ↦ (t⁻¹ • (z.1 - ξ), z.2)
      invFun := fun z ↦ (ξ + t • z.1, z.2)
      left_inv := by
        intro z
        ext1
        · simp [smul_smul, ht.ne']
        · rfl
      right_inv := by
        intro z
        ext1
        · simp [smul_smul, ht.ne']
        · rfl
      continuous_toFun := by fun_prop
      continuous_invFun := by fun_prop }
  let H : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ) := F.comp Φ.toCocompactMap
  have hHsupp : tsupport H ⊆ U ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : Φ z ∈ tsupport F := tsupport_comp_subset_preimage F Φ.continuous hz
    refine ⟨?_, trivial⟩
    have := hF _ hz'
    simpa [Φ, smul_smul, ht.ne'] using this
  set K : Set (Euclidean N) := Prod.fst '' tsupport H with hKdef
  have hKc : IsCompact K := H.hasCompactSupport.isCompact.image continuous_fst
  have hKU : K ⊆ U := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact (hHsupp hz).1
  have hfin := V.finite_on_compact K hKc hKU
  have hsuppK : Function.support H ⊆ K ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) := by
    intro z hz
    exact ⟨⟨z, subset_tsupport _ hz, rfl⟩, trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := H.hasCompactSupport.exists_bound_of_continuous H.continuous
  have hHint : Integrable (fun z ↦ H z) V.measure := by
    have hOn : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ H z) (K ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) V.measure :=
      Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := M) hfin H.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Eventually.of_forall hM)
    exact (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset hsuppK).mp hOn
  have hmap : Integrable (fun z ↦ F z) (V.measure.map Φ) :=
    (integrable_map_measure (map_continuous F).aestronglyMeasurable
      Φ.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable).mpr hHint
  exact hmap.smul_measure ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
key_steps: H := F ∘ Φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G) with tsupport H ⊆ U × G (Φ the blow-up homeomorphism).
K := fst(tsupport H) is a compact subset of U and V.measure(K × G) < ∞.
H is bounded and supported in K × G, hence V.measure-integrable.
integrable_map_measure transfers integrability to (V.measure).map Φ, and Integrable.smul_measure to the factor ofReal(t^{-n}).
